rules.statement: The purchaser's remedy for obtaining possession from a party bound by the decree entered in his favor, who is not a necessary party to the mortgage action but has failed to register her address, can be treated as an order made under section 12(1) of the Mortgage Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: In my opinion the order made by the District Judge is an order that he could have made under section 12 (1) of the Mortgage Ordinance.
